{{Top|leg|canon=Holo-letter}}
A '''hololetter''' was used for individuals to leave messages for each other.

While [[Zekk]] was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], he received hololetters from [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] the ''[[Lightning Rod]]'', one of which detailed a battle on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kuar]] where [[Tyko Thul]] was kidnapped by the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] and bounty hunter [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]].<ref name="YJK: DoG">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur]]''</ref>
